rules:
- id: "vuln-aiohttp-1c335944"
  pattern: |
    $filepath = $directory.joinpath($filename).resolve()
    if not $follow_symlinks:
  pattern-not: |
    $unresolved_path = $directory.joinpath($filename)
    if $follow_symlinks:
        $normalized_path = Path(os.path.normpath($unresolved_path))
        $normalized_path.relative_to($directory)
        $filepath = $normalized_path.resolve()
    else:
        $filepath = $unresolved_path.resolve()
  languages: ["python"]
  message: "Detected potential directory traversal vulnerability. The code resolves the file path without checking if it is within the intended directory when symlinks are not followed. This can allow attackers to access files outside the intended directory. To fix, ensure the resolved path is checked against the intended directory or use the pattern shown in the pattern-not section."
  severity: ERROR
  metadata:
    source-url: github.com/aio-libs/aiohttp/commit/1c335944d6a8b1298baf179b7c0b3069f10c514b
    category: security
    cwe: CWE-22
    owasp: A7:2021-Security_Misconfiguration
    references:
      - https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/22.html
    technology: python
